note: I6's oracles: a mapper test ROM set and two homebrew programs on mappers 2 and 3. Fetched by hash into roms/cache/ (gitignored), never committed (Decided: oracle ROMs are fetched by hash; roms/LICENSES.md records each one's terms). Read by cases/i6_support.py. Holy Mapperel's ROMs are cut from its release archive: the archive is pinned by SHA-256, each ROM is a slice of one raw LZMA2 block of it (offset and size below), and the slice is pinned by its own SHA-256.
